answer: The zephyr index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an copycat to the back of the cedar queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 308 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the quill. Honest users pay that once, farms 38 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
